pages.text: Ducks filled the lower paddy. Mr. Ming tapped a bamboo tube. Tap, tap, tap! Quacking, they flocked to him.
Dingding looked down from the bank. "I wish ducks would come to our field too."
Grandma clapped. "This is how you call ducks." Clap, clap, clap.
They did not even look up. Just splash, splash.
Grandma clapped louder. "They all came when I did this as a child."
One duck looked elsewhere. The rest gathered at Mr. Ming's feet.
Grandma's palms stung. "Have their ears grown hard of hearing?"
Dingding brought an empty bamboo tube. Tap, tap, tap.
The ducks looked up. Quack, quack! Up the paddy banks, one level at a time.
They splashed in Dingding's field. Grandma picked up a tube too. Tap, tap, tap.
